<documents>
<document id="card-lost-stolen-v2">
LostˆorˆstolenˆcardˆIfˆyourˆcardˆisˆlostˆorˆstolen,ˆyouˆcanˆdealˆwithˆitˆinˆtheˆappˆinˆaˆcoupleˆofˆminutes.ˆYouˆdon'tˆneedˆtoˆcallˆus.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆdoˆ1.ˆ**Freezeˆtheˆcard.**ˆTapˆCardsˆandˆswitchˆFreezeˆcardˆon.ˆThisˆstopsˆnewˆpurchasesˆrightˆaway.ˆ2.ˆ**Reportˆit.**ˆIfˆyouˆcan'tˆfindˆit,ˆtapˆReportˆlostˆorˆstolen.ˆThisˆcancelsˆtheˆcardˆpermanently.ˆItˆcan'tˆbeˆundone.ˆ3.ˆ**Addˆaˆvirtualˆcard.**ˆYouˆcanˆcreateˆoneˆinˆtheˆappˆandˆuseˆitˆonlineˆandˆinˆmobileˆwalletsˆrightˆawayˆwhileˆtheˆreplacementˆships.ˆ4.ˆ**Orderˆaˆreplacement.**ˆPickˆstandardˆorˆexpeditedˆshipping.ˆReplacementˆandˆshippingˆfeesˆdependˆonˆyourˆplan.ˆ5.ˆ**Checkˆyourˆtransactions.**ˆDisputeˆanythingˆyouˆdon'tˆrecognize.ˆ##ˆDeliveryˆStandardˆshippingˆtakesˆ7ˆtoˆ10ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆExpeditedˆshippingˆtakesˆ2ˆtoˆ3ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆUnauthorizedˆtransactionsˆYou'reˆnotˆresponsibleˆforˆunauthorizedˆcardˆtransactionsˆyouˆreportˆwithinˆ60ˆdaysˆofˆtheˆstatementˆtheyˆfirstˆappearˆon.ˆIfˆyouˆfoundˆyourˆcardˆafterˆfreezingˆit,ˆjustˆunfreezeˆit.ˆNothingˆelseˆchanges.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="plan-fee-refunds">
RefundsˆofˆplanˆfeesˆWeˆrefundˆtheˆfirstˆpaidˆplanˆchargeˆonˆyourˆaccountˆinˆfullˆifˆyouˆleaveˆtheˆpaidˆplanˆwithinˆ14ˆdaysˆofˆthatˆcharge.ˆWeˆcallˆthisˆtheˆcooling-offˆperiod.ˆ##ˆHowˆitˆworksˆ-ˆItˆappliesˆonlyˆtoˆtheˆfirstˆpaidˆplanˆchargeˆyourˆaccountˆhasˆeverˆhad.ˆLaterˆcharges,ˆevenˆafterˆswitchingˆplans,ˆaren'tˆcovered.ˆ-ˆWhenˆyouˆaskˆforˆtheˆrefund,ˆyourˆplanˆreturnsˆtoˆBasicˆrightˆawayˆratherˆthanˆonˆyourˆnextˆbillingˆdate.ˆ-ˆTheˆrefundˆgoesˆbackˆtoˆyourˆmainˆbalance,ˆusuallyˆwithinˆminutes.ˆ##ˆWhatˆisn'tˆrefundedˆOutsideˆtheˆcooling-offˆperiod,ˆplanˆfeesˆaren'tˆrefundedˆorˆprorated.ˆThatˆincludesˆtheˆmonthˆinˆwhichˆyouˆdowngradeˆandˆtheˆmonthˆinˆwhichˆyouˆcloseˆyourˆaccount.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆaskˆMessageˆsupportˆinˆtheˆappˆandˆsayˆyou'dˆlikeˆtoˆcancelˆyourˆpaidˆplanˆunderˆtheˆcooling-offˆperiod.ˆSupportˆcanˆprocessˆitˆforˆyouˆstraightˆaway.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="security-new-device">
SigningˆinˆonˆaˆnewˆdeviceˆWhenˆyouˆsignˆinˆonˆaˆnewˆphoneˆorˆcomputer,ˆweˆaddˆaˆshortˆsafetyˆperiod.ˆ##ˆWhatˆchangesˆForˆ24ˆhoursˆafterˆtheˆfirstˆsign-inˆonˆaˆnewˆdevice,ˆBrookPayˆpaymentsˆandˆtransfersˆtoˆexternalˆaccountsˆareˆlimitedˆtoˆ$500ˆinˆtotal.ˆCardˆpayments,ˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆandˆdepositsˆaren'tˆaffected.ˆ##ˆWhyˆIfˆsomeoneˆstealsˆyourˆpassword,ˆtheˆfirstˆthingˆtheyˆusuallyˆtryˆisˆmovingˆmoneyˆoutˆquickly.ˆTheˆlimitˆgivesˆyouˆtimeˆtoˆnoticeˆtheˆsign-inˆalertˆandˆtellˆus.ˆ##ˆCanˆsupportˆliftˆitˆearly?ˆNo.ˆTheˆlimitˆendsˆonˆitsˆown.ˆSupportˆcan'tˆremoveˆit.ˆ##ˆSign-inˆalertsˆWeˆsendˆanˆalertˆtoˆyourˆotherˆdevicesˆandˆyourˆemailˆwheneverˆaˆnewˆdeviceˆsignsˆin.ˆIfˆitˆwasn'tˆyou,ˆchangeˆyourˆpasswordˆandˆmessageˆusˆrightˆaway.ˆ##ˆSwitchingˆphonesˆIfˆyouˆknowˆyou'llˆneedˆtoˆsendˆaˆlargeˆtransfer,ˆdoˆitˆfromˆyourˆoldˆphoneˆbeforeˆyouˆswitch,ˆorˆplanˆaroundˆtheˆwaitingˆperiod.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>
